notes.title: Project Alpha Requirements
notes.content: Need to review the IAM module and test the biometric fallback mechanisms before Tuesday.

This application is a centralized enterprise platform designed to securely manage employees, identities, access permissions, attendance, work assignments, and organizational security. It provides separate Admin and Employee portals, ensuring that employees can access only their authorized information and resources while administrators have complete control over users, roles, permissions, requests, and security activities.

The platform strengthens authentication through employee identity verification, device recognition, precise GPS-based location verification, login-time analysis, and behavioral monitoring such as typing patterns. These factors can be combined to calculate a dynamic risk score and identify suspicious or unauthorized access.

Administrators can manage employees, departments, roles, permissions, access requests, attendance, tasks, documents, and reports from a centralized dashboard. Employees receive a personalized workspace where they can manage their profile, view assigned tasks through a calendar-based to-do system, track attendance and leave, submit access requests, and monitor their own work activities.

The system also provides analytics, audit logs, governance reports, security monitoring, and an AI-powered workspace assistant that can analyze enterprise data, explain security risks, summarize activities, assist with reports, and support administrators and employees with everyday tasks.

The overall objective is to provide organizations with a secure, practical, and centralized solution for **identity management, access governance, employee management, and continuous security monitoring** using a Zero Trust approach.
